_comment: Shared settings inherited by every experiment. Model configs override only what differs, which is what makes the architecture comparison fair.

data._comment_classes: BUSI ships benign/malignant/normal. The thesis research question is binary, so 'normal' is excluded by default. Set include_normal=true and add 'normal' to classes for the 3-class variant.
data._comment_group: Images are grouped by source lesion id so no lesion can appear in more than one split. This is the fix for the leakage measured in the previous dataset (77.3% of test images had a near-duplicate in train).

augmentation._comment: TRAINING SPLIT ONLY. Applied on-the-fly after splitting, never to val/test.
augmentation._comment_vflip: Vertical flip is disabled: breast ultrasound has a fixed acquisition orientation (skin line at top, depth increasing downward), so a vertical flip produces anatomically impossible images.

training._comment_cw: BUSI is imbalanced (437 benign vs 210 malignant). Balanced class weights penalise missing the malignant class more heavily.

evaluation._comment_thresh: A missed cancer costs more than an unnecessary follow-up, so the operating point is chosen for high sensitivity rather than at the default 0.5.
